subject: You are in charge this week
body:
I am out for seven days. You run the camp now.

Everything happens through the terminal in the office. Read every mail. Bookings have an Accept and a Reject button - use both. Rejecting is not rude, it is management.

- Teta Vera

subject: First day check
body:
Good luck on your first day.

If the inbox starts screaming, breathe and sort the customer mail first. Call me before midnight, you promised.

subject: Forecast packet delayed
body:
Satellite relay delayed by atmospheric noise.

Expect stale weather metadata for a few hours.

subject: Pending settlement batch
body: Settlement batch will clear at end of day after guest departures are processed.

subject: Supplies
body:
There is a lockbox under the reception desk with cash for basic camp expenses. Do not waste it on junk.

And open the CAMPSTAT program now and then. It has a tab for the power bill and a tab for the nights. Both matter.

subject: The radio
body:
Leave the radio in the office playing at night. Your uncle said the guests sleep better when they can hear it from the tents.

I think he meant himself.

- V.

subject: Tariff reminder
body:
Your account is billed nightly at 20:00 local.

Unpaid invoices carry a three day grace period. After that the supply is interrupted and the backup unit in the office will hold the site for approximately six minutes.

This message is automated.

subject: Occupancy scan
body:
Automated report:
- Mail feed active
- Occupancy scan complete
- 1 occupied unit without an assigned guest ID

Ticket closed automatically. No action required.

subject: Photo from town
body:
I walked past the old bus stop. It looks exactly like the wallpaper on your camp computer. Same bench, same sign.

Who took that photo?

subject: Still alive there?
body:
Hey,

Did you sleep at all or are you still camping in that office chair?

Please eat something and do not answer chain mails.

subject: Water meter note
body:
Quick note: the old water meter still drifts at night. If guests complain, tell them we are scheduling service.

It has been drifting for eleven years. Nobody is scheduling anything.

subject: count them
body:
you counted them at check-in

count them again after 22:00

the number is not the same

subject: Night log
body:
02:58  gate closed
03:00  all guests accounted for
03:01  operator asleep at desk

No incidents.

subject: Operator registry ping
body:
This is an automated registry ping.

Confirming daily occupancy logs can be submitted retroactively.

subject: Checking in
body:
Are you answering the booking mails or are you letting them pile up? Guests who wait do not come back, and the ones who do come back leave reviews.

- Teta Vera

subject: Socks
body:
You were up late again. The grey socks are in the second drawer, the office floor is cold in the morning.

- V.

subject: Weekend warning
body:
Weekend traffic is building. Expect larger groups asking for tomorrow arrivals.

Do not confirm what you cannot host.

subject: Settlement batch cleared
body: Settlement batch cleared. One guest record could not be matched to a payment and was carried over.

subject: (no subject)
body:
The lamp by the lake was on all night. Good. Keep it on.

Do not walk along the fence after the lamps go out. Your uncle did.

- V.

subject: Call me
body:
You did not call. That is fine. I called the camp number instead and somebody picked up and listened for a while.

Was that you?

subject: Mailbox throughput report
body:
Automated report:
- Mail feed active
- Filter confidence: degraded
- Sender verification unavailable

Recommendation: manual review for all customer bookings.

subject: Tomorrow
body:
Your aunt is back tomorrow, right? Then you are back the day after.

I kept your seat on the bus.

subject: Coming back tomorrow
body:
Train arrives in the morning. Leave the books on the desk and the terminal on.

I will count them myself.

- Teta Vera
